name: R024-pursuit-ko-on-switch
why: The player's Haunter (set 179) and Banette (set 237) are Ghosts and switch with each other every turn. The opponent's lead Raticate (set 197: Endeavor, Pursuit, Scary Face, Quick Attack) picks a random move at challenge 1; Endeavor and Quick Attack cannot touch a Ghost, so only Pursuit hurts. When Raticate picks Pursuit (1 in 4 per turn) it strikes the Pokemon that is switching out at double power, super effective: about 127-150 on Haunter (139 HP) and 73-86 on Banette (148 HP). The second hit on the same Pokemon is a sure knock-out (a Haunter hit often is one already), so getbattlerfainted after Pursuit's switch-out hit reports the faint. Raticate never switches (it has a super-effective move).
